insight.title: Why the world reflects your inner weather
insight.subtitle: Understanding the invisible lens of the human mind.

sections.text: We think we see the world exactly as it is. In truth, we see it as we are. Every morning, you wake up and look through a silent filter. It colors the sky, the coffee, and the faces you pass. Life is not a movie; it is a mirror.

Your mind is a master of patterns. It takes a million tiny signals and weaves them into a story you can understand. It looks for warmth where it expects kindness. It finds shadows where it fears the dark. You are the artist, painting the scenery with your own quiet history.

This realization changes everything. When the day feels gray, you can look for the light within. You begin to see that your feelings are not facts, but softly whispered suggestions. By shifting your perspective, you invite a new season. The world stays the same, yet it becomes beautifully new.

news.title: Iran's new leader injured, 'likely disfigured' - Hegseth
news.description: Iran's new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei is wounded and likely disfigured, US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth says.

news.title: Early exposure to a high-fat diet alters how the adult brain reacts to junk food
news.description: Poor nutrition during pregnancy sets the stage for future brain health issues. Scientists discovered that a brief taste of unhealthy food in adulthood sparks massive inflammation in rats exposed to a high-fat diet before weaning.

news.title: Study shows one single dose of LSD reduces anxiety for months
news.description: Research finds that a single dose of LSD can alleviate the symptoms of anxiety in those who do not find relief from other current treatments

news.title: Iran War: US Intensifies Strikes, Rhetoric as Oil Rises
news.description: President Donald Trump said the US had bombed military targets on a critical Iranian outpost in the Persian Gulf and threatened additional strikes targeting oil infrastructure if Tehran continued to block energy flows, in the latest escalation of the two-week conflict that has upended the region.
